pages.text: The Terrestrial Habitat raises captured baby animals into adults and can keep adults for renewable production.$(br)$(br)Growth recipes consume the baby animal and food, producing the same individual as an adult plus manure. Renewable recipes keep the adult animal in place: chickens produce eggs, cows produce milk through the Fluid Output Hatch, and sheep produce wool matching their captured color.

Renewable tier 1 cycles keep 1 adult and consume 2 food, 250 mB water and 32,000 FE for 1 egg/wool or 1,000 mB milk, plus 1 manure. Tier 2 uses 4 feed, 500 mB and 64,000 FE for 3 products (3,000 mB milk), plus 3 manure.$(br)$(br)At a steady 512 FE/t these take 63 or 125 processing ticks (about 3.15 or 6.25 seconds). Less power or blocked outputs extends the cycle. Both item and milk outputs must fit before inputs are consumed.

Datapacks can add renewable recipes for goats or modded captured species. Use biotech:captured_animal with an EntityType selector, BiotechRecipeLifecycle set to adult, and isConsumable set to false. Define any registered item/fluid outputs and the desired food, water and energy costs.$(br)$(br)Milk is minecraft:milk and Biotech enables it itself. Goat examples for each target are included in the production datapack documentation.

pages.title: Construction
pages.text: 7 × 7 × 6 animal-care habitat with three distinct masses: a raised stepped-roof rear shelter, an airy low-glass exercise run, and a lower offset feeding/service pod. A freestanding entrance arch beside the controller provides a two-block-wide, three-block-high opening. The open run has no overhead box frame; the level path leads into the illuminated shelter. Seven exposed ports retain their 2.6 positions.$(br)$(br)41 frame, 19 framed glass, 1 grow light, 59 panel, 6 vent, 16 grass block. Plus the controller and 7 hatches shown in the preview.$(br)$(br)Only the current guide layout forms. Retired 2.5 layouts and the 2.6 Habitat require rebuilding. Finish active cycles and empty hatches before updating; do not break a loaded controller or hatch. Smart Hammer fills cleared spaces from inventory but cannot replace solid blocks.
